parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to obtain cluster IDs.

parameters.name: ReleaseInstance
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to release Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances that are created by using Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC).

Default value: true.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc delete-cluster --cluster-id ehpc-hz-QKKVqO0000 --release-instance true --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
